summary: Mobile Plan & Billing breakdown verified against the shared backend for FAMILY (2 & 3 participants) and SOLO (3 participants). The reported bug — mobile showing hardcoded $49.50 with no participants/add-ons row even when a 3rd participant was added — is FIXED. Breakdown now correctly reflects included participants, extra add-ons at $24.50, and the correct Fortnightly total. useFocusEffect reload works.

test_scenarios.case: FAMILY, 3 participants (cathy + added TestExtra via POST /v2/participants)

seed_data_creation: Added and then hard-deleted a TestExtra Third participant on cathy@example.com to exercise the 3-participant case (final count restored to 2: Dorothy, Patricia).
critical_code_review_comments: plan-billing.tsx L116: activeCount fallback uses participants.length when the filter yields 0 — could hide removed participants during an in-flight reload but not a functional issue as ParticipantContext already filters status='removed'/'purged' upstream. Safe as-is.

SOLO edge case: if a solo user somehow has 0 active participants, breakdown shows '0 (1 included)' with total $24.50 (correct math). Not a bug, just an odd UI string; matches web behaviour so parity is preserved.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (Family, 2 participants baseline; add-participant scenario driven via POST /api/v2/participants). trial30909@example.com / TrialPass1! (Solo trialing, 3 participants).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The mobile Plan & Billing breakdown card (billing-breakdown) is now participant-driven and correctly matches the web. cathy@example.com in preview has exactly 2 participants (Dorothy + Patricia), not 3 as previously documented in test_credentials.md — update if you rely on that. To reproduce the 3-participant case, POST /api/v2/participants and then re-open /plan-billing.
rca of the issue: Previously mobile plan-billing hardcoded the total to the base plan price and did not read from ParticipantContext. Fix: consumes useParticipants(), computes included=(family?2:1), addonCount=max(0,active-included), baseFortnight=(family?49.5:solo?24.5:0), fortnightTotal=base + addonCount*24.5. useFocusEffect triggers reloadParticipants() on screen focus so counts stay fresh after navigating from the Participants screen.
